speaker: A17Y8Z3QQIF9J4
text: Hi. How are you? I'm chatting to you from Tennessee.

speaker: A3A07QA5U733HQ
text: Howdy neighbor! I'm here in Alabama.

speaker: A17Y8Z3QQIF9J4
text: That's a beautiful place. Many of my ancestors came from Alabama. How do you feel about children's charities? There are a lot of suffering children in the world.

speaker: A3A07QA5U733HQ
text: I feel that they're good. I work at a Children's hospital so I see children suffering everyday.

speaker: A17Y8Z3QQIF9J4
text: I used to work at a Children's hospital too! In Chattanooga! Well I'm probably going to donate a portion of my earnings to the Save the Children charity They work globally and have are great reputation.

speaker: A3A07QA5U733HQ
text: What did you do there?

speaker: A17Y8Z3QQIF9J4
text: At the children's hospital? I was a respiratory therapist. So the researcher will handle the donation and make sure it gets to the right people. Would you care to donate something as well?

speaker: A3A07QA5U733HQ
text: I would like to donate too. I'm a biomedical equipment technician at my hospital.

speaker: A17Y8Z3QQIF9J4
text: That's awesome. I'm glad you're donating. Even if it is a small amount. The charity helps feed, educate, clothe and provide healthcare for kids. They are working with those poor babies in Syria that have suffered so much. How much do you feel you want to donate?

speaker: A3A07QA5U733HQ
text: I'm thinking .75 would help.

speaker: A17Y8Z3QQIF9J4
text: That sounds great to me. You can choose any amount between 0 to $2.00. Thank you for your compassion.

speaker: A3A07QA5U733HQ
text: No problem. I agree that the defenseless need help.

speaker: A17Y8Z3QQIF9J4
text: I used to drive through Alabama delivering oxygen supplies to nursing homes. I would go to Huntsville, all the way to Gadsten. It's so beautiful. Sad that there are so many poverty stricken areas. Lots of needy kids there too, just like Tennessee. I love the south though.

speaker: A3A07QA5U733HQ
text: I used to live in Huntsville and my mom's from Gadsden. Now I live in South Alabama between Gulf Shores and Mobile.

speaker: A17Y8Z3QQIF9J4
text: Oh lucky you! You're near the beach. I've been to Florida's beaches and South Carolina but not Alabama. I want to go. Heard it's very nice.

speaker: A3A07QA5U733HQ
text: They are pretty nice. I love it down here. Moving down here is one of the best decisions I've made.

speaker: A17Y8Z3QQIF9J4
text: Are you really close to the water? We don't get to the ocean too much. It's about a 9 or 10 hour drive from here. How cool, that you have a great job and an awesome place to live!

speaker: A3A07QA5U733HQ
text: Where I'm at now I'm about 2 miles from the bay and about 45 mins from the Gulf. I just bought a house just north of here. I'll be an hour from the Gulf there.

speaker: A17Y8Z3QQIF9J4
text: It sounds wonderful. I'm sure the beaches are covered with white sand like Florida. I think we're close to being done with our chat. It's been pleasant and thanks again for agreeing to donate.

speaker: A3A07QA5U733HQ
text: Yeah they are pretty white. Florida's beaches are slightly better though. It has been great chatting with you!

speaker: A17Y8Z3QQIF9J4
text: Have a good night.
